definitions.gloss: these guys; these fellows; these ones
definitions.explanation: A rough, informal plural pronoun referring to people or things near the speaker. Formed from こいつ (this one, this guy) plus the pluralizing suffix ら. Can express contempt, familiarity, or casual affection depending on context.

examples.japanese: こいつら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任|まか}せろ→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧。
こいつら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やっている→やる：02980_yaru⟧んだ。
こいつら⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しく→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I'm with these guys, things always get fun.

notes:
The plural form of ⟦こいつ→こいつ：08268_koitsu⟧ (this person/thing), formed by adding the suffix ら. Like ⟦こいつ→こいつ：08268_koitsu⟧, it is a rough or blunt form and can sound rude, dismissive, or contemptuous when used about people. However, among close friends it can also express casual warmth or in-group familiarity.

Can also refer to animals or objects, not just people.

REGISTER:
Very informal and masculine-leaning. Inappropriate in polite company or formal situations. The neutral equivalents would be ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち (these people) or ⟦これら→これら：02814_korera⟧ (these things).

RELATED PRONOUNS:
- ⟦こいつ→こいつ：08268_koitsu⟧: this guy/thing (singular) — same rough register
- ⟦そいつ→そいつ：08759_soitsu⟧ら: those guys/things (near listener) — same pattern with そ-
- ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧ら: those guys/things (distant) — same pattern with あ-
- {奴|やつ}ら: those guys — similarly rough plural pronoun
